findings.what: If the offered slot was booked directly in the meantime, accept fails and the entry reverts to 'offered'; the sweep then marks it 'expired', so the patient drops off the waitlist and loses their queue place with no slot.
Recording leave does not touch waitlist entries or offers already sent for that doctor/date; those patients stay 'waiting' forever and are never told.

The leave check runs before the booking transaction; if leave is recorded at the same moment as an online booking, a booked appointment can land inside the leave range without being flagged rescheduling_required.
Nothing stops the same email from joining the same doctor+date several times, so one patient can take several queue places.

README still says patients can cancel any time before the start and does not mention v2 at all (no waitlist, leave, CANCELLATION_WINDOW_HOURS or offer sweep); VIP and the penalty were dropped without saying they were deferred.
The freed slot is not held while the offer is out, so a direct booking can take it first; documented in the code comment but weakens 'take the freed slot'.
